scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @doc/api && npm run build --workspace @doc/worker && npm run build --workspace @doc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -b apps/api apps/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @doc/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names api,worker,web,processor 'npm run dev --workspace @doc/api' 'npm run dev --workspace @doc/worker' 'npm run dev --workspace @doc/web' 'npm run dev:processor'
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @doc/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @doc/worker
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @doc/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,worker,web,processor 'npm run start --workspace @doc/api' 'npm run start --workspace @doc/worker' 'npm run start --workspace @doc/web' 'npm run start:processor'
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml up --build --detach --wait --wait-timeout 120 && npm run storage:init
scripts.db:setup: npm run setup:env && npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/database.ts setup
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/database.ts migrate
scripts.db:status: npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/database.ts status
scripts.db:rollback: npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/database.ts rollback
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && tsx scripts/database.ts seed
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build && DOC_FRONTEND_TESTS=1 npm run test:ingestion
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run && npm run test:python
